item.title: 260421 Dream Journal
item.description:
260421 Dream Journal
Description
I was living in a big house with Kyle and my sister. There was a traveling salesman and Kyle opened the door and which let in a bunch of cats and their kittens. I follow them. The kittens are really cute but swarmed Rot who started fighting them at first but then warmed up to them over time.
Bianca had her sticker business set up on like a self serve wall. One of the sticker sheets got punched through the middle.
I was looking at a Google map view of our current location and looking at pop up restaurants nearby. At some point Kevin was at some transit stop close by.
Kyle was organizing tax documents for his whole family.

Psychoanalysis

Anytime I dream about Rot, it's a reflection of myself. Rot is a demon but is often a reflection of my unconscious instincts. While I won't go charge others like that dumbass dog, I do view my most pieces of my surroundings as a threat.
Here's what dream-moods has to say about chihuahuas: To see a Chihuahua in your dream represents someone around you who is unexpectedly vocal. It may also represent someone who is insecure. Alternatively, the dream may refer to a situation or relationship where the bark is larger than the bite.
Is it referring to me, or my sister?
Maybe the issues we have stem from insecurity but being made more complicated than it is? How to interpret the kitten attack?
To see a kitten in your dream represents a transitional phase toward independence. You are ready to explore new things that life has to offer. Alternatively, the dream symbolizes innocence and purity.
To dream that you kill a kitten in your dream indicates that you have trouble expressing yourself in a personal relationship. You are feeling frustrated in this relationship.
Hmm.. Well I can see myself having trouble expressing myself to my sister who often talks over me and interrupts. Maybe the short-lived kitten attack is representing my detachment from my perceived 'responsibility' to my sister. And I can be independent and happy in my own way.

To see or study a map in your dream suggests that your current life path will lead to fulfillment of your needs and realization of your goals. It also indicates that you are set on the path to self knowledge and self discovery. If you have difficulties understanding or reading the map, then it means that you are feeling lost. You are literally still trying to find yourself and figure out where you want to go in life.
I'm not sure how to interpret the map part. I know I love studying maps in my real life, so I don't think I'm lost. I suppose a need to discover and plan?
Lastly, I think I want Kyle to do my taxes. I am subconsciously desiring to be part of his family so he can do my fuckass taxes?
